items.title: 13.1 Chlorine, bromine aur iodine ki volatility (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.1, printed page 293.

blocks.text: Chlorine kamre ke darja hararat par bohat volatile hai aur hawa mein jaldi phail jati hai (print use liquid kehti hai; yeh gas hai). Bromine, ek liquid, chlorine se kam magar iodine se zyada volatile hai; yeh kamre ke darja hararat par aasani se bhaap ban kar zehreele dhuen chhorti hai, narangi bukharat aur teez, badboo ke saath (us ka naam Greek 'bromos', badboo, se hai). Iodine teenon mein sab se kam volatile hai: kamre ke darja hararat par us ki solid halat chlorine aur bromine se kam volatility dikhati hai. Is liye volatility chlorine se iodine tak ghat-ti hai, group mein neeche barhte molecular mass, bare bairooni shell aur mazboot intermolecular (London dispersion) quwaton ki wajah se.

blocks.prompt: Chlorine bromine aur iodine se zyada volatile kyun hai (Quick Check 13.1c)?
blocks.explanation: Chlorine molecules teenon mein sab se chhote aur halke hain, sab se kam electrons ke saath, to un ke darmiyan instantaneous dipole-induced dipole quwatein sab se kamzor hain; molecules alag karne ko thori energy chahiye, aur chlorine gas hai jo foran phail jati hai, jabke bromine liquid aur iodine solid hai.

items: Volatility Cl2 zyada Br2 se zyada I2 se: yeh group mein neeche barhte molecular mass, size aur London dispersion quwaton ke saath ghat-ti hai.
